## Shared scenes

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a dramatic final goodbye due to her mother's orders, though they remain secret friends. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and enters an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
